dossiers.exact_definition: Stage IIIB small cell lung carcinoma that has spread to the pleural fluid.
dossiers.specialty: thoracic pathology, thoracic oncology, and lung-cancer registry staging
factual_context: AJCC v7 malignant pleural effusion is M1a/stage IV while IIIB is M0; generic C3331 does not establish malignant cytology.
NCIt C6681 and C6682, current AJCC staging, and the historical v7 conflict are separate evidence contexts.
StageSystem C141685 is engineering-only under #271 and cannot receive a human action.

citations.exact_passage: M1a Separate tumor nodule(s) in a contralateral lobe; tumor with pleural nodules or malignant pleural (or pericardial) effusion. | T4 (pleural effusion) | M1a | IV | IV | IV | IV.
citations.supports: Under AJCC v7, malignant pleural effusion is M1a and stage IV, conflicting with the row's Stage IIIB label/value.
citations.does_not_support: Generic pleural effusion C3331 alone does not establish malignancy, and the manual does not authorize an NCIt repair.
citations.limitations: Historical seventh-edition lung criteria; current editions are separate contexts.
citations.conflicts_or_supersession: Historical v7 must not be silently replaced by current AJCC, but its own M1a/stage-IV rule directly conflicts with this row.
